Before they played

  • Saturday · 6 p.m.Slab
  • Saturday · 1 a.m.Galaxy Barn
  • Sunday · 9 p.m.Woods

Since as of November 2026

Rat Saw God came out on Dead Oceans in April 2023, four months before the festival, and Stereogum paired the band with MJ Lenderman as the lineup's critics' picks. They played Primavera Sound that June.

At Pickathon

Their Saturday-night set drove through grunge, post-punk and alt-country, mostly from Rat Saw God, and Paste called it its favorite rock performance of the year.

Since · as of November 2026

Rat Saw God finished 2023 as album of the year at both Paste and Stereogum. Bleeds followed on Dead Oceans in September 2025, after a Colbert appearance that May.

With The Expressions he played late-night Galaxy Barn and a Mountain View set that KEXP streamed live. Twelve years later, at 73, he commanded the stage in a sparkly coat, and Spectrum Culture said it was the closest you'll come to seeing James Brown live.

A documentary, Lee Fields: Faithful Man, came out in 2024, and in 2025 he was special guest on the Alabama Shakes reunion tour. He opened 2026 at Razzmatazz in Barcelona.

Liner notes

Before they played

W.I.T.C.H., short for We Intend To Cause Havoc, formed in Kitwe, Zambia, in 1972, led by Emanyeo 'Jagari' Chanda. They mixed the Rolling Stones, Black Sabbath and James Brown with village songs, and reissue labels brought them back into print, including Now-Again's We Intend to Cause Havoc! in 2011.

At Pickathon

On the Woods Stage, Jagari ate cherries mid-set while the band roared, and the Portland Mercury called it a masterclass that turned everyone into forever fans.

Since · as of November 2026

Zango, their first studio album in nearly forty years, came out in 2023. Sogolo followed in June 2025.

Watchhouse

Pickathon 2023

Liner notes

Two North Carolinians who started in coffee shops came to the farm in 2014 as Mandolin Orange, and came back as Watchhouse.

Before they played

Andrew Marlin and Emily Frantz formed Mandolin Orange in Chapel Hill in 2009 and signed to Yep Roc in 2013. When Pickathon first invited them in 2014 they were still playing coffee shops and small rooms.

At Pickathon

As Mandolin Orange they played the Lucky Barn and filmed Wake Me for Pickathon's own On the Farm series. By 2019 they were back as headliners. Under the new name they played Saturday night at Cherry Hill with Marlin's voice worn thin, and the audience listened to every song. Haley Heynderickx took their Sunday Woods slot at the last minute.

Since · as of November 2026

As Mandolin Orange they reached the Billboard 200 with Tides of a Teardrop in 2019, then renamed the band Watchhouse in 2021. Rituals, their first album of all-new songs since 2021, came out in May 2025 and made Rolling Stone's list of the year's best country and Americana albums. They headlined Red Rocks on October 3, 2021 and the Ryman on November 8, 2025.

Legend

Broken Social Scene

Pickathon 2018

Liner notes

Broken Social Scene are the Toronto indie collective that launched Arts & Crafts and Feist's career, and we booked them to headline our two biggest days.

Before they played

They won the Juno for Alternative Album of the Year twice, for You Forgot It in People in 2003 and for the self-titled record in 2006. Hug of Thunder (2017) took a Pitchfork 8.4 and a Metacritic 76, and made five year-end lists, three of them top ten.

At Pickathon

Gigwise called their closing set sprawling and witty, a fitting end to the 20th Pickathon.

Since · as of 2026-11-15

Remember the Humans, their first album in nine years, came out on May 8, 2026, and they toured North America with Metric and Stars that summer.
